readme.description: Start here: commands, folders, and what verification establishes.

target.description: Antigen Target FASTA, retaining original supplied text for a custom upload. The snapshot records the analyzed normalized sequence.

parents.description: Complete Mimicry Parent FASTA, including records without matches; original supplied text is retained for custom uploads.

parentRecords.description: Identifiers, original headers, normalization and metadata for all selected parents, in FASTA order. Sequences are stored once in the FASTA.

projection.description: When needed, original input records, exact coordinate mappings, and exclusions for the selected comparison.

snapshot.description: Frozen result, identity threshold, selected window, and captured ordering used for table reproduction.

recordMappings.description: Frozen record identities and assay projections. Checksum-verified supporting reference, not a regenerated output.

matchesCsv.description: All Window Pairs across the Antigen Target at the captured threshold; no display limit.

parentsCsv.description: Overall Mimicry Parents: every matching record in the captured order, with directional coverage and best identities.

export-core.js.description: The same CSV and table implementation used by the site.

ranking.js.description: The captured Window Pair and Mimicry Parent ordering rules.

projected-events.js.description: Coordinate projection and assay contribution handling for mapped comparisons.

custom-worker.js.description: The site's CPU worker for optional independent input rescans.

layout.description: Versioned file roles and paths shared by the browser exporter, source ZIP builder, and offline runner.

TABLES.md.description: CSV field meanings, counting units, coverage, ordering, and empty-table interpretation.

RUNNING.md.description: Verification modes, troubleshooting, language wrappers, and the public FASTA pipeline.

FILE-GUIDE.md.description: Folder and file dictionary, including the former flat filenames.

GLOSSARY.md.description: Definitions generated from the site's single terminology authority.

comparison.description: This export's target, scope, threshold, counts, selected window, and pooled Antigen Target Coverage.

pipeline.description: Configurable FASTA pipeline using the same CPU worker; separate from frozen-result verification.

fasta-input.js.description: The browser Custom FASTA parser and normalization, shared with the offline pipeline.

mimicryone-identity.js.description: The same header and public protein-label resolver used by the browser.

ensure-node.py.description: Local Node.js runtime setup for Python/R launchers; reuses a compatible installation or downloads a checksum-verified private copy.

ensure-node.R.description: Local Node.js runtime setup for Python/R launchers; reuses a compatible installation or downloads a checksum-verified private copy.

node-runtime.tsv.description: Local Node.js runtime setup for Python/R launchers; reuses a compatible installation or downloads a checksum-verified private copy.

parallel-scan.cjs.description: CPU scheduling for local scans; automatically selects concurrency with an optional worker-count override.
